reactor_type: Beneq TFS 500 with a HS 200 hot source and an ozone generator
evidence: Deposition temperatures from 250 to 400 /C14 C were tested in steps of 50 /C14 C. The pulsing times of Yb(thd)3 and O3 were varied from 200 ms to 1 s and from 1 to 6 s, respectively, while the purge time was kept at 2.5 s for Yb(thd)3 and 3.25 s for O 3.
